text: Hi Anna, thanks for sending the draft yesterday. I read through it this morning and I think the structure works well, but the second section needs more detail about the budget and the timeline for the pilot. Could we talk about it after lunch tomorrow, maybe around two?

Quick note for the team before Friday. The new onboarding flow is ready for testing on the staging server, so please try it with a fresh account and write down anything that feels slow or confusing. I am especially interested in the email confirmation step, because last week a few people said the link expired too early. If you find a bug, open a ticket and add a short video if you can. We will review everything on Monday morning and decide whether we ship it next week. Thanks again for all the careful testing and the help this month.
